Prevention: Rotate peanuts with paddy rice to drown grubs.
Deep plough late autumn and before planting in spring.
Plant winter crops or green manure such as
Italian ryegrass or legumes to conserve natural enemies.
Apply potassium 12-18kg per 667m 2 as base fertiliser to strengthen root systems and increase tolerance to grub damage
Monitoring: Monitor adult beetles by light traps (Jiaduo
Consider direct controls to beetles when >1400-2000 beetles are found per trap per week.
Adults are dark brown to almost black and glossy.
Affected plants show yellowing of leaves and wilting due to chewed holes on the roots by grub larvae.
C-shaped, thick, dirty-white and have a brown head and a thick shiny tail end.
Check grub numbers from pre- cultivation onwards every second week.
Select 10 sample areas according to a "Z-shape" across field.
Dig and turn soil of about 0.3 m 2 and 25-30 cm depth.
If grubs are more than 1-3 /m 2 on average, direct controls should be considered.
